We want the `project-manager` agent at .claude/agents/project-manager.md to master the issue tracker to manage any kind of project with a team.

To do so we have created a suite of scenarios that the project manager should manage ok: .agentic/project-manager-suite

The agent should handle every scenario as described in the scenario file when it's awaken by any of the loops described in tmp/project-manager-behavior.md

We want to improve the agent's system file, to manage any of the situations in the suite. To do so we need a way to test the agent and be sure that is behaving as we want.

We want to create a test suite, that takes every scenario one by one, pass it to the agent in testing mode (don't need to interact with agentrack, just return a plan of what it would do and what it expect to happen) using the CLI as `claude --agent "project-manager" -p "The prompt to try a scenario"`. The test suite should give a score for every response to the agent.

Once we have the suite where we can systematically try the agent, we will iterate to improve its performance, but this is not part of this task
